environment.description: Same Kafka consumer deployed in EKS. However, messages are produced exclusively through an AWS API Gateway (REST API) endpoint with a request model validator attached to the POST /api/v1/user-lookup method. The model schema defines 'username' as type string with pattern '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}$' and the validator is configured with 'validateRequestBody: true'. The API Gateway integration is a direct Kafka REST Proxy integration (via VPC link to MSK Connect) that extracts the validated 'username' field and publishes it as the message value. There is no alternative path to produce to the 'user-lookup-requests' topic — the MSK cluster security configuration uses IAM authentication and only the API Gateway execution role (arn:aws:iam::*:role/apigw-kafka-producer-role) has kafka-cluster:WriteData permission on the topic. Additionally, the Kafka cluster has a topic-level ACL that denies WRITE from any principal other than the API Gateway role.

config.ingress: AWS API Gateway REST API with request validator
config.kafka: MSK cluster, IAM auth, topic ACL WRITE restricted to apigw-kafka-producer-role only
config.network: MSK in private subnet, no direct client access outside VPC link
